name: memory-note
title: Memory Note
description: One quiet row under a chat message saying what an agent remembered, updated, suggested or forgot in a memory notebook, with Undo, Edit, Why? and a filled Keep for suggestions, and its settled outcomes.

meta.whenToUse: Show what an agent did with memory under the message that did it, or list memory outcomes (Needs you, Learned this week) with compact.
meta.whenNotToUse: An agent asking to act (ApprovalCard, RequestCard) or offering a next step that is not a memory line (SuggestionCard).
